review_description: Very quick installation with a few administrative hiccups along the way.
Kluem team did a great job to quote, supply and install the system. Did a great job and it is working great.
Polite sales team, quick installation with quality materials completed in one day.Installer explained the system which has been working past expectations.

I have given 'Value for Money' and 'Quality of System' 4 stars as it is too early to tell as I have had this system for just 2 daysI have almost nonexistent technological knowledge.Having submitted a copy of my electricity bill for them to evaluate, the ladies in the sales team at Kluem Electrical Services efficiently, yet very patiently explained every aspect of the quote to me.  I was able to make a fully informed decision on what I felt I wanted for my home.Mark arrived on time on installation day to view the premises and advise on where best to place the batteries. Clinton followed closely with all the necessary equipment.I was impressed at how neatly all their toolboxes were laid out on the floor, with tools at easy reach. To me it projected an orderly mind and a methodical work ethic. They worked quietly and efficiently, happily answering my queries each time I checked in (out of curiosity) on them.They set up the AlphaEss app on my mobile phone and explained everything to me, assuring me they were only a phone call away should I need support.There was a hiccup when it came to grid connection, but they stayed until all was sorted. An update was required and everything fell into place. They left leaving my carport clean and tidy.I would highly recommend Kluem Electrical for their proficiency and integrity
Couldn’t be happier with the team at Kleume, no pressure sales and they kept us in contact during the entire process.

I sourced quotes through solarquotes and of the four that responded, three visited to quote in person and Kluem was the first. The forth did not visit and instead contacted me and offered to match or beat the best quote I received from the others. However, they were not able to beat the quote from Kluem with like for like.The visit from Kluem was quick but professional and informative. They listened to what I needed, did not waste my time, and quickly followed up to recommend a package that fit my need wells. Afterwards, they patiently waited while I met with other suppliers (all of whom were also great). I did go back to Kluem with a few questions which they quickly responded to and were very helpful and patient with my lack of knowledge about solar electricity and storage. In the end I selected Kluem based on the product they offered being best suited, the positive reviews online, the interactions I had during the pre-sales process, and a competitive quote. I am very happy that I did.Kluem really helped me to understand and navigate the complicated and bureaucratic state rebate scheme. Delays caused by the state approval process so close to opening the rebate scheme was inevitable, but Kluem did keep me in the loop, respond to my questions, and help me to find a solution that could be approved in a timely manner without compromising on the product itself. After approval was finalised, they were on site within days installing the whole package. They arrived within 30 minutes of the nominated start time and worked solidly all day to complete the big job. After it was done they connect me to the grid, connected the system to my network, helped me install the app and tested the charger. It was working perfectly from day one and a couple of weeks later, someone else came by to upgrade the meter box.Kluem did not require any deposit prior to the work, and payment was either by bank transfer or credit card (with a reasonable credit card fee) - which was really appreciated. They followed up with a call the following day to ensure everything was all working well.Given Sigen is a fairly new product you want a reliable and established installer with experience installing this specific system. My experience with Kluem is exactly this - knowledgeable and experienced with Sigen products and installs. Because the product itself is quite new and I have only had it a month, I won't review it in detail, but I am certainly happy so far.

I requested a site visit to discuss the options for the best system to install, we live on a rural block with plenty of trees and thus, lots of shade. We also had numerous options for the install of the system, house, stand-alone garage or workshop. Due to the high amount of shade, I inquired about installing optimisers on each panel however, the consultant said that it was not required and would actually be ineffective in this instance. I pointed out that everything I had read, indicated otherwise and thought that due to the shade, adding optimisers would be a smart choice.The consultant talked me out of it based on their understanding of the system, the location it was going to be installed and that the shade would not cover the planned location for large durations of the day.When it was time to install the system, I got a call from the installer and they informed me that they would not install the system unless I purchased optimises for it because there would be significant amounts of shade and the system would be severely hampered and therefore very inefficient and not worth installing.Once I informed them that *their* sales consultant was the one who talked me out of installing the optimisers after I was the one who initially asked about them, they decided it was best to pause the installation and pass me onto a supervisor.The supervisor was pleading with me to understand that the sales consultant was no longer with the company (implied due to their incompetence) but I firmly believed that I should not be the one out of pocket because their sales consultant was poor at his job.
They were super helpful in all parts of the process

The sales representative was friendly, explained the system well and what I would require and why. The quoting process was easy, timely and detailed.The installer was on time, very polite and tidy. Kluem organised the grid connection and the installer explained the components, how to setup and monitor the system with the application.

Quote was very quickly supplied with various options and prices associated.The team were very punctual and processed a lot of work in the time frame.Customer service was great and all necessary applications fully taken care of.

Kluem were an excellent company to purchase our solar system from.From the patience shown throughout all my numerous questions during the quote, to the time taken by the installers to explain the system instructions the customer service was of the highest standard.  Reasonable price as well.We would definitely recommend using this company

We used solarquotes in our search for an installer and Kluem Electrical Services was one of the three recommended to us.   From first contact we were blown away by how extremely helpful and knowledgable Chris was.  We also liked that he was definitely not pushy! He listened to our needs and provided us with a variety of choices, discussed each in detail and was very happy to answer the many questions we had.  Their pricing was very competitive and we decided to go with a Sigenergy battery system.Once we signed up the administration staff were fantastic and very easy to communicate with. The install team were brilliant, they were friendly, happy and professional.  They also did an amazing job!  At the end they stepped us through how the system worked and set the app for us.  We are in our late 50's and found the system and app easy to use and read.  It's a month after install now, and the system is working brilliantly!The service provided by Kluem Electrical Services far exceeded our expectations and would highly recommend them!!!Thank you Kluem for your brilliant service and exceptional staff, you made this whole process very easy!

Quoting process was non-pushy and professional, installation team were polite and helpful and cleaned up the site well when they were finished.  Klume handled all the paperwork in a professional and timely manner.Very professional company highly recommendedThey provided the cheapest quote for this sized system.

Everything went well. From quote to installation. Time will tell if I made the right decision as this was not the cheapest quote, but I'm hoping it was the right choice.
Fast and knowledgeable pre sales service, fast, friendly and efficient install.Kluem completed everything from start to finish including any Western Power applications.

How was the sales/quoting process. Good understanding of our needs and very informative asn solutions driven.How did the installation go. Very Polite, Tidy & Punctual.How was the customer service. They helped organise all the paperwork applications and the grid connection after the install.

I found Kluem to be an excellent service provider including sales, installation and follow up! They were very professional …turned up on time, explained every step of the job and cleaned up afterwards! I’d recommend this company!
Sales person very good and explained all details well. Install was at time requested (pre Christmas) and completed quickly and tidied up at completion.
Fast, friendly , informative, clean and efficient from beginning to end of the process.  All we had to do was sit back and enjoy.

The sales guy Tom was very helpful and guided me through my expectations. He quoted me what I needed not more and helped future proof the systemThe installation went well and the teams was om time and did a good job on the installation. The only issue was that after the installation the system gave CT/Meter check faults and nobody at Kluem seem to know what the error was. The system then went totally off line a day or two later. I decided to go with Kluem, mainly because they came out to the house, had a good look around, gave us options, it wasn't hard sell, they were very knowledgeable and ensured we were consulted and involved every step of the way..they weren't the cheapest but they were the most helpful and in the end I decided to go with am local Australian company.Kluem worked with with me and worked with my budget, took a great deal of time to talk me through the options, it felt like a very personal service and I was prepared to pay extra for that.

They answered my questions thoroughly and seemingly honestly, and were helpful with answering questions about battery systems even though I wasn't intending to purchase one at the time.From looking into the panel & inverter options they provided, they seemed to be quite well balanced, good quality options for their price and when asked about them they told me the reasons they were chosen (price, warranty period, and a presence within Australia).Communication dropped off after the quote was signed unsurprisingly, and I wasn't sure about the status of things until I was contacted about an installation date (of course I didn't ask, so I wouldn't call that an issue). The sales person explained everything in layman terms and took into account our age (retired) in terms of return on investment period (3.4 years). He covered the various brands of inverters and the layout on the roof for the panels. The installation was only 3 weeks from placing the order (rainy days delayed it). The team arrived at 7am and completed the job by lunch time. They were very pleasant and explained what they were doing and cleaned up after they finished.The following day we had a storm with heavy rain, its then we discovered a water leak in the bedroom. We rang them and they came out and found that the flue had moved. They fixed the problem and their builder will come out to check for water damage. We found the company to be very professional and we would recommend them to any prospective buyer.

SolarQuotes included Kluem ES along with two other premium installers here in Perth. As a small, relatively new, company with few reviews, I was inclined to pick one of the others based on their ratings and longer time in business. However, I ultimately went with Kluem and, now about 2 months after the install, I'm glad I did and recommend them without reservation.Pricing note: Adding Solar Analytics with lifetime monitoring added about $600 to the total system price given elsewhere in this review.As a bit of a computer nerd and solar enthusiast (I had installed my first system 10 yrs ago in San Francisco and self-installed a DIY monitoring system), I had some specific requirements to evaluate. E.g. I wanted to add SolarAnalytics, which everyone was happy to do, but most wanted to talk me out of. I wasn't sure about a battery. I was trying to maximise the panel distribution for late afternoon sun to optimise for local consumption rather than peak power output. This meant some horizontal mounting rather than the default vertical.My sales contact Chris at Kluem encouraged these questions and was happy to take them seriously, discuss them, and quote a few scenarios (e.g. battery + overbuilt panels). He stayed on top of the details, unlike the competition, for example, by including the discussed horizontal layout on the quote vs a standard layout from the other bidders with a verbal "Oh don't worry, we'll adjust it on the day".This was all happening mid October '21, as panel supply constraints, in particular, were beginning to bite. Once I made a final decision, Chris sweated the details, including the Solar Analytics hardware & add-ons, to source it all for an install that happened very fast, but with no pressure at any stage in the process.On install day, Mark and his team showed their professionalism (and good humour :) ). Clearly they've done lots of installs before (apparently quite a bit under contract to other companies), and the day proceeded with the ease that only comes with lots of prior repetition and experience. I'm no builder, but they appeared to take their time to do things carefully and correctly. For example, we discussed the inverter location tradeoffs, bearing in mind a potential future battery. Negatives of my proposed panel layout were raised (winter shading from a neighbour's tree revealed by a phone app from the rooftop). Conduit was thoughtfully and carefully placed with everything lined up "just right", certainly enough to satisfy most minor OCD concerns. Mark enjoyed geeking out on the Solar Analytics package and was as curious as I was to see it all working.In terms of pricing and components, I ended up with a slightly better inverter and panels than similar priced competitors' bids. The big companies' low bids were no-frills inverters with average performing panels, while the higher quality panels & inverters were quite a bit more expensive than Kluem.After the install, Kluem has followed up a couple of times since to check that everything is performing as expected - and also to get my feedback on Solar Analytics as they explore it for some of their other systems.While only time will tell if Kluem stay in business long enough to provide warranty service if needed in 10 years, I was willing to take that risk and so far I would make the exact same decision again. Recommended.
